method: Port of ANALYSIS/OPENSWATH/TargetedSpectraExtractor except searchSpectrum (needs AccurateMassSearchEngine) and storeSpectraMSP (needs the MSP writer; its two preparation steps are ported). The class-test sections that do not need MSP libraries are transcribed with their literals and TEST_REAL_SIMILAR tolerance; the target list is built in the test from the class test's CSV for the fields the class reads.
evidence_tier: tier 3 (class-test literals: parameters, pickSpectrum, annotateSpectra both overloads, scoreSpectra both overloads, selectSpectra both overloads, extractSpectra both targeted overloads, mergeFeatures, annotateSpectra with MS1 features, constructTransitionsList, storeSpectraMSP's peak removal); tier 4 (matching with a fixed-score comparator, BinnedSpectrumComparator self-match and option parsing, Rust-only refusals)

fixtures.role: The class test's target list; the test builds the equivalent TargetedExperiment from it (TransitionTSVFile is not ported)

class_test_review.comparison: TEST_EQUAL exact; TEST_REAL_SIMILAR as isRealSimilar with absdiff 1e-5 and ratio 1 + 1e-5.
class_test_review.not_transcribed: matchSpectrum, targetedMatching, untargetedMatching and the MS1-feature extractSpectra section load MSP files through MSPGenericFile; the searchSpectrum section runs AccurateMassSearchEngine; storeSpectraMSP's file round trip needs MSPGenericFile::store.
